mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bom_snapshot (source_version, status, checksum, error_message, effective_at) VALUES (#{sourceVersion}, #{status}, #{checksum}, #{errorMessage}, #{effectiveAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE bom_snapshot SET status=#{status}, checksum=#{checksum}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, effective_at=#{effectiveAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bom_snapshot WHERE status = 'READY' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
